Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you regularly filter, sort, and group your tasks to get the right view of your work, you no longer need to rebuild that setup each time you open a project. Saved Views lets you capture a specific combination of filters, sorting, and grouping, then return to it with a single click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from a personal daily checklist to a filtered backlog for one sprint. Views can also be shared with your team, so a manager's status report or a designer's queue is a click away for anyone who needs it, without recreating the setup from scratch. It's a small change that adds up over a busy week.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, and works across boards, lists, and timelines.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
